# ⚡ Kubernetes Command of the Day (2026-08-13)

## 📌 Trigger Graceful Rolling Restart of Deployment

```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/myapp
```

| Metadata | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Category** | `Workloads` |
| **Difficulty** | `Intermediate` |
| **Safety Rating** | **🟡 Caution** |
| **Verification Status** | Verified ✅ (Verified on local test cluster.) |

---

### 📖 What It Does

Triggers a controlled rolling restart of all pods managed by a Deployment without service downtime.

### 💡 Why It Is Useful

Pick up updated ConfigMaps, Secrets, or clear transient process memory leaks safely.

### 💻 Practical Example

```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/myapp -n production
```

### Command Breakdown

- `rollout restart`: Update pod template annotation to trigger immediate rolling update sequence.

### ⚙️ Prerequisites

Requires active `kubectl` connection and appropriate cluster permissions.

### ⚠️ Common Mistake

Running against the wrong namespace or context without checking current-context first.
